Best- vs worst-predicted answer-side SAE features (issue #1482)

What is shown. The 150 best-predicted and 150 worst-predicted answer-side SAE features (Set A, global tails) of the issue-1482 context-features → answer-features ridge map, each with the abstraction level a Sonnet judge assigned from its top-8 strongest-firing assistant answers.

Per-arm provenance. Answers are on-policy Qwen-2.5-7B-Instruct seed-42 generations from the parent run (the SAME single generation pool for every feature — no per-arm generation difference); SAE feature activations are teacher-forced BatchTopK (k=64) encodings of layer-19 residual-post activations of those answers; per-feature R² is the committed held-out R² of the context-features→answer-features ridge (eval_results/issue_1482/sae_perfeature/sae_ctx__mean__ridge.npz); activity is the fraction of fit rows in which the feature is answer-active; within-answer consistency is the mean fraction of an answer's tokens where the feature fires, given it fires at all (eval_results/issue_1482/feature_correlates/consistency_perfeature.npz). Answer snippets are shown verbatim with no substitutions, truncated at 400 characters — every truncation is marked inline. Snippets are real user-facing assistant text from the parent corpus and are not screened for content.

Judge instrument. claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929, reason-then-label, max_tokens 400, one draw per feature, malformed/out-of-range returns dropped never coerced (drops: {'content': 0, 'transport': 0}); rubric sha16 2774598533dbdcc3 — identical to the reference feature-correlates round; test-retest κ = 0.599 (n = 60). Neuronpedia auto-interp descriptions ride each judge item as labeled auxiliary evidence.

Set A (this dashboard, global tails)frac judged high-level: best 0.566 vs worst 0.248 (of low+high); Fisher p = 0.000. Activity-confounded by construction — median activity best 0.16142 vs worst 0.11540.
Set B (activity-controlled read)frac judged high-level: best 0.521 vs worst 0.248; decile-stratified permutation p = 0.000.

基态是指原子、分子或其他物理系统中能量最低的状态。在原子物理学中，基态是指原子中所有电子都处于可能的最低能量状态，通常也包括原子核的能量状态。对于分子来说，基态是指所有分子轨道都充满电子，并且这些电子都占据能量最低的轨道。 基态是所有量子态中最稳定的状态，因为在这个状态下，系统的总能量是最小的。任何与基态的能量状态不同的量子态，我们通常称其为激发态。 了解基态和激发态对于很多物理学和化学问题的研究非常重要，特别是在原子物理学、分子光谱学、量子化学等领域。通过研究原子、分子等物质在不同量子态下的性质，科学家们可以揭示这些物质的基本物理和化学行为。
